'''Brook lampreys''' are an aquatic [[vermin]] found year-round in nearly any [[temperate]] body of [[water]], and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] brook lampreys for their ''beauty''.
